falseFriends.actual: Use 'фактический' or 'реальный', not 'актуальный' (which means 'current/relevant'). In OEE: 'фактическое время цикла' (actual cycle time), not 'актуальное время цикла'.
falseFriends.magazine: Use 'журнал' for periodical, not 'магазин' (which means 'store'). In manufacturing: 'магазин' can also mean tool magazine/cartridge.
falseFriends.cabinet: Use 'шкаф' for storage/electrical cabinet, not 'кабинет' (which means 'office'). Electrical control cabinet = 'шкаф управления'.
falseFriends.station: 'Станция' is acceptable for workstation in manufacturing but can mean train station. Engineers may prefer 'рабочий стенд' or 'пост' in some contexts.
falseFriends.effective: Use full 'Общая Эффективность Оборудования' or ОЭО for the OEE metric. Generic 'эффективность' alone loses the OEE-specific meaning.
falseFriends.performance: Use 'производительность', never the anglicism 'перформанс' (which means artistic performance/show in Russian).
falseFriends.scrap: Use 'брак' (defective production output), not 'скрап' (metal scrap for recycling) or 'металлолом' (scrap metal).
falseFriends.setup: Use 'переналадка' (SMED changeover) or 'наладка' (initial machine setup). Not 'настройка' (software/system configuration).

grammarNotes.caseSystem: 6 grammatical cases. Nominative for labels: 'Готовность', 'Производительность'. Genitive for 'of X': 'причина простоя' (stop reason), 'расчёт OEE' (OEE calculation). Accusative for objects: 'рассчитать OEE'. Instrumental: 'измеряется в процентах'.
grammarNotes.aspectSystem: Verbs have perfective/imperfective aspects. Perfective for action buttons: 'Сохранить' (Save), 'Удалить' (Delete), 'Добавить' (Add). Imperfective for ongoing: 'Сохранять' (keep saving) — avoid for standard buttons.
grammarNotes.genderAgreement: 3 genders affect adjective forms: 'незапланированный простой' (m), 'дополнительная смена' (f), 'плановое время' (n). Adjective endings must match noun gender.
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Decimal: comma (,). Thousands: space. '85,5%' not '85.5%'. '1 000 единиц'. OEE ratio: '0,855'. Consistency required across all numeric fields on same screen.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: Singular genitive modifier is PREFERRED for manufacturing UI labels: 'причины потери скорости' (reasons + loss [gen.sg] + speed [gen.sg]). Plural genitive 'причины потерь скорости' (losses [gen.pl]) is grammatically valid when treating losses as countable events but should be treated as a soft warning, not a hard error. For automated audit purposes, treat singular genitive as correct. Flag plural genitive forms for G3 native speaker review.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: Both Cyrillic ОЭО and Latin OEE are used; ГОСТ Р 56407-2015 defines ОЭО. Practitioner preference: english_dominant — post-2022 domestic MES vendors (Zyfra, TRIM, Solisoft) all use OEE (Latin) in UIs. ГОСТ mandates ОЭО for formal standards documents but practitioners and software use OEE.
industryContext.dominantVendors: Post-2022: 1C:ERP (dominant domestic), Galaktika ERP, Zyfra Диспетчер (MES), TRIM/НПП СпецТек (EAM/MES), Solisoft LMS OEE. Legacy: SAP, Oracle, Siemens. Import substitution (импортозамещение) policy promotes Russian software.
industryContext.leanAdoption: Medium-high. Rosatom Production System (РПС) is one of world's largest lean deployments. ГОСТ Р 56000 family (~10 lean standards). AvtoVAZ-Renault partnership brought French lean practices.
industryContext.industrie40: 'Индустрия 4.0'. 'Цифровая экономика' (Digital Economy) national program. MES: 'МЕС' or 'MES'. 'Цифровой двойник' (digital twin).

commonMistakes: Using 'актуальный' for 'actual' instead of 'фактический' — the #1 cross-Slavic false friend
Using Latin 'OEE' when 'ОЭО' is appropriate in formal/GOST-aligned contexts (or vice versa in international contexts)
Using 'доступность' (IT accessibility) for OEE availability — correct term is 'готовность' (GOST-aligned equipment readiness)
Using anglicism 'перформанс' for OEE Performance — correct: 'производительность'
Case errors in compound terms: 'причина простоя' (genitive, correct) must become 'причины простоев' in plural genitive, not 'причина простоев'
Using informal 'ты' instead of formal 'Вы' (capital) in professional manufacturing software

Compound plural modifier ambiguity: 'причины потерь скорости' vs 'причины потери скорости' — genitive plural 'потерь' vs singular 'потери'. Singular modifier treats 'speed loss' as a concept; plural treats losses as countable events. Prefer singular for UI consistency; flag for G3 native speaker review
notes: OEE (Latin) is english_dominant in Russian manufacturing — post-2022 domestic MES vendors (Zyfra, TRIM, Solisoft) all use OEE in UIs despite ГОСТ Р 56407-2015 mandating ОЭО. Full expansion 'Общая Эффективность Оборудования' kept for phrase contexts. Formal Вы in professional contexts. Key availability term: 'готовность' (GOST), not 'доступность' (IT availability). Length multiplier 2.5 (P95=2.00, consistent with all Slavic peers).
